source_name: PISRS / Uradni list RS — ZPlaSSIED and Banka Slovenije sklepi on payment systems
why_relevant: The legal substrate under which SI payment systems are authorised and supervised: ZPlaSSIED (consolidated text effective 9 Oct 2025) plus Banka Slovenije sklepi on supervision fees and payment-system decision procedures. Gives the statutory deadlines and authorisation conditions that scheme operators must meet.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register of Supervised Entities (English mirror)
why_relevant: English-language equivalent of the master register; useful for entity-type labels and for cross-mapping Slovenian legal categories to EU terminology (payment institution, EMI, AISP, credit servicer). Observed change-log entries such as the withdrawal of BANKART's AISP registration.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register of payment institutions (EN payments-supervision section)
why_relevant: Dedicated entry point for payment-institution licensing lists (authorised PIs, PIs with waiver/exemption, registered AISPs). Directly serves the payments half of the run scope.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Seznam notifikacij plačilnih institucij (passporting notifications, PDF/catalogue)
why_relevant: Codebook/catalogue for the list of inbound passporting notifications of foreign payment institutions into Slovenia — i.e. the foreign PSP population competing in SI without local licence. Complements the EBA PSD2 register with the national view.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Izdana dovoljenja Banke Slovenije (issued authorisations)
why_relevant: Flow (not stock) view of licensing: disclosures of authorisations issued, including qualifying holdings in banks and savings banks post-ZBan-2 (after 13 May 2015). Turns the static register into a dated event stream — new entrants, ownership changes, licence extensions.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Licenciranje (licensing procedures)
why_relevant: Explains which licences exist, under which acts (ZBan-3, ZPlaSSIED, ZPotK-2), and what procedural requirements/deadlines apply. Provides the legal taxonomy needed to interpret register categories and to anticipate consultation/deadline topics.

source_name: EBA – Register of payment and electronic money institutions under PSD2
why_relevant: EU-wide central register aggregating national registers; lets you enumerate SI-authorised PIs/EMIs/AISPs and, critically, every foreign PI/EMI passported INTO Slovenia and every SI entity passported OUT. Machine-readable downloads make it the best cross-border population source for the SI payments market.

source_name: EBA – Credit institutions register
why_relevant: EU/EEA list of authorised credit institutions plus EEA branches, with CRD passporting context. Provides the authoritative cross-check on the SI bank/savings-bank population and on EEA banks branching into Slovenia.

source_name: EBA – Registers and other lists of institutions (hub)
why_relevant: Parent hub listing all EBA registers (credit institutions, PSD2 payment/EMI, crowdfunding, credit servicers, etc.). Snowballing this page yields further EU-level populations that include SI entities.

source_name: ECB Banking Supervision – List of supervised entities (SI significant institutions and LSIs)
why_relevant: Country-by-country list separating ECB-directly-supervised significant institutions from less significant institutions supervised by Banka Slovenije. Determines which SI banks answer to SSM vs national supervision — decisive for who publishes what compliance news and which consultation regimes bite.

source_name: ATVP – Register dovoljenj za opravljanje investicijskih storitev in poslov / seznam članov jamstvenega sistema
why_relevant: Authoritative list of firms (including banks) licensed for investment services in SI plus members of the investor-claims guarantee scheme — a cross-cutting list that identifies banks operating beyond core banking.

source_name: ATVP – Začasni register ESMA v zvezi s kriptosredstvi (MiCA)
why_relevant: ATVP's pointer to the ESMA interim MiCA register, which is where SI-authorised CASPs and CASPs passported into SI are published. Crypto/payments overlap: MiCA competence in SI is split between ATVP and Banka Slovenije (EMTs/ARTs), so this identifies a new regulated-actor population relevant to payments.

source_name: ATVP – Register ponudnikov individualnih naložbenih računov (INR)
why_relevant: Newer product-specific register naming the banks/investment firms offering individual investment accounts — a leading indicator of which institutions are launching new regulated retail products.

source_name: AJPES – Poslovni register Slovenije (PRS) / ePRS
why_relevant: Central business/court register for all Slovenian legal entities. Provides matična številka, legal form, address and ownership-registration data for every licensed financial actor found in the supervisory registers — the identity backbone that lets you deduplicate and canonicalise entity names across BS, ATVP, EBA and ECB lists. Also reveals new fintech incorporations before they appear in any supervisory register.

source_name: OPSI – Poslovni register Slovenije open dataset
why_relevant: Bulk, openly licensed XML extract of the PRS updated twice monthly (registration number, name, address, legal form, registering body, HSMID). The practical machine-readable route to the SI entity universe without scraping ePRS.

source_name: OPSI – Banka Slovenije publisher datasets
why_relevant: Catalogue of all Banka Slovenije datasets published as Slovenian open data (balance-sheet series, exchange rates, and supervisory catalogues such as the payment-institution notification list). A structured alternative to scraping bsi.si for anything already published as open data.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Centralni kreditni register (CKR)
why_relevant: Statutory credit register; its list of reporting members (poročevalci) is effectively another census of credit-granting institutions in SI, including leasing and non-bank lenders that may not appear in the supervisory register. Underlying credit data is not public, but membership/reporting obligations and instructions are.

source_name: Wikipedia – Seznam bank v Sloveniji / List of banks in Slovenia
why_relevant: Unofficial but convenient consolidated list of SI banks with historical merger/rebrand lineage (useful for name normalisation across decades of register snapshots). Must never be used as the authoritative population — only as an alias/lineage aid.

source_name: Konsentus – analysis of the EBA registers (data-quality commentary)
why_relevant: Vendor analysis documenting known inconsistencies, lag and duplication in the EBA PSD2 register and national registers. Useful as methodological guidance on how far to trust register-derived counts for SI, and it flags that national registers (like bsi.si) remain the legal source of truth.

source_name: Open Banking Europe / PRETA – PSD2 registration & passporting guide
why_relevant: Explains how PSD2 registration and passporting entries are structured across national registers and the EBA register — the interpretation key for reading SI passporting entries correctly (host-state vs home-state, service codes).

source_name: NLB Group Investor Relations (Odnosi z vlagatelji)
why_relevant: NLB is Slovenia's largest bank and the only listed one (LJSE + LSE GDR). Its IR hub carries SREP/P2R capital-requirement announcements, MREL decisions, Pillar 3 disclosures and regulatory-impact commentary — the clearest demand-side read on Slovenian/SSM supervisory action.

source_name: NLB Pillar 3 disclosures (Razkritja po 3. stebru baselskih standardov)
why_relevant: Annual and semi-annual CRR Part Eight disclosures containing TSCR/P2R/P2G levels, buffer requirements, MREL, and narrative on incoming regulatory change (CRR3/CRD6, DORA, ESG risk). Machine-comparable across years.

source_name: SEOnet — Ljubljana Stock Exchange regulated-information portal
why_relevant: Statutory channel (ZTFI-1) through which NLB and other listed Slovenian financial issuers file inside information — including SREP capital-requirement decisions, MREL notifications and dividend-restriction news. Acts as a single pointer feed replacing per-bank page polling for listed issuers.

source_name: OTP banka d.d. (Slovenia) — Financial reports and documents
why_relevant: Post-merger entity of Nova KBM + SKB (+ Abanka, PBS legacy). Hosts annual reports, Pillar 3 razkritja, interim reports and legacy archives — the single richest private-bank documentary trail in Slovenia, including remuneration disclosures under CRR Art. 450.

source_name: OTP banka (ex-NKBM) customer notices on general terms / fee schedule changes
why_relevant: Splošni pogoji + cenik changes must be notified to customers two months in advance under ZPlaSSIED/PSD2. These notices are the earliest observable signal of product/pricing changes driven by regulatory deadlines (instant payments, VoP, PSD3, DORA-driven outsourcing terms).

source_name: SKB banka legacy report archive (within OTP banka site)
why_relevant: SKB merged into OTP banka on 2 Sept 2024 (legal merger 22 Aug 2024). Historic SKB annual reports and disclosures remain the baseline for pre-merger regulatory/compliance positions; archive now mirrored under otpbanka.si. skb.si itself is being wound down — capture before link rot.

source_name: Addiko Bank Slovenija — Obvestila za stranke
why_relevant: Dedicated customer-notice feed. Observed to carry regulation-driven items (EU Instant Payments Regulation effective 9 Oct 2025, CHF loan conversion offers, package/T&C changes) — a compact, high-signal page for regulatory deadlines hitting retail products.
